result.summary: The page is generally well-designed with no critical issues. Minor observations include a partially cut-off carousel card (likely intentional swipe affordance) and low-contrast secondary text in the restaurant cards.

issues.description: The third restaurant card (Trattoria Piccol...) in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen
issues.suggestion: This is likely an intentional horizontal scroll affordance, but ensure enough of the card is visible with a peek effect so users understand it's scrollable

issues.description: Delivery fee text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery') under restaurant names in the horizontal carousel is low-contrast gray on white
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color slightly to improve readability

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (pizza) has a heart/favorite icon on a dark semi-transparent circle, while the badge '−20%' uses white — the favorite button contrast differs from the first card's white-outline heart on dark image
issues.suggestion: Ensure favorite buttons have consistent, sufficient contrast across all card backgrounds
